title: Vintage fan round
subtitle: Eight fan shells radiating from the centre in a flat circular motif
excerpt: Eight shell fans spread outward from the magic ring in a flat circle, each fan filling a 45-degree section. Four rounds build the fans to their full width; a dc border round closes the outer edge. The motif reads as a slightly rounded octagon — square enough to join in a grid but soft enough to read as circular.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 3 (1888), fan circular motif chapter (Internet Archive). Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopedia of Needlework (1886).
heroPrompt: A vintage fan round crochet motif in warm cream DK cotton on a pale linen background, photographed flat from above in soft daylight. Eight radiating fan shells, slightly octagonal outline, 12 cm across.

crochet.gaugeText: Finished vintage fan round measures 12 cm across in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Vintage fan round
chartDefinition.caption: Eight fan sections. Each fan starts with 3 tr and expands to 7 tr by round 4. Chain-2 spaces between fans.

glossaryTerms.definition: A group of trebles all worked into the same chain space, spreading outward like an open fan. The number of trebles in the fan determines the width of the spread.

content.text: grow outward from the magic ring, each sitting in its own chain-2 space. The fan expands from 3 trebles in round 1 to 7 trebles by round 3, then the dc border round closes the outer edge and gives a solid outline for joining.

Work in a single colour for a clean geometric look. Two colours — fans in one, border in another — give a clear contrast edge. The motif joins at the dc border round with whip stitch through back loops.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 12 g of DK-weight cotton. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle and scissors.

content.text: Magic ring. *3 tr into ring. Ch 2.* Rep 8 times. Sl st to join. Close ring. (24 tr, 8 ch-2 spaces.)
Sl st into ch-2 sp. *5 tr into ch-2 sp. Ch 2.* Rep from * around. Sl st to join. (40 tr, 8 ch-2 spaces.)
Sl st into ch-2 sp. *7 tr into ch-2 sp. Ch 2.* Rep from * around. Sl st to join. (56 tr, 8 ch-2 spaces.)
Work 1 dc into each of the 7 fan trebles. Ch 1 into each ch-2 sp. Continue around. Sl st to join. Fasten off.
Work the kaleidoscope round for a multicolour version where each fan section uses a different colour.
